provenance.recipe: Unmodified original dynamic raw f32 Tensor sqrt/log2 and ONNX ReduceL2 final outputs; one final realization, no forced intermediates. Programs carry exact independent original LLVM source/optimized schedule and binary hashes.
provenance.scope: Native CPU float32 direct-input sqrt and one contiguous trailing-axis reduced scalar from direct float32 input. All normalization, batched, strided, computed and ambiguous axis/value-map contexts are original-valid unsupported controls; no general LLVM scheduling equivalence is claimed. Only a sole selected final norm/Sqrt output is admitted; jointly exported square CSE and downstream fusion stay unsupported.
provenance.additional_capture_recipe: Raw q/sNaN payload normalization and rank1/rank3 strided/multiple-axis reductions extend the independently generated original corpus; all expected bytes are original CPU:LLVM results. Computed Mul/Gelu/Gemm captures select norm alone or norm and computed output simultaneously before one execution; neither context is treated as proof of a barrier.

cases.name: ReduceL2-held-square-65-payload
cases.native_pending_reason: Jointly selected square introduces original CSE/materialization; only sole selected final primitive is admitted.

joint_computed_not_materialized.rule: Reject every non-Input square operand until computed fusion is implemented; joint graph outputs do not prove materialization.

normalization_operand_priority.rule: Original optimized VMULPS selects row reciprocal first when both operands are NaN. Preserve that operand unchanged only in the admitted norm-reuse helper; no general NaN normalization.

packed_square_rounding.rule: Port original UNROLL plus packed-product SLP rounding; not one FMA for every square.

cross_row_slp.resolution: Reject multiple reduced scalars structurally; original cross-row masked-gather/FMA LLVM vectorization is not implemented. Prior batched positives do not establish general scheduling equivalence.

scalar_normalization_packing.resolution: Normalization admission removed; reciprocal reuse and packing-sensitive NaN priority require original LLVM scheduler port. Strict FDIV also fails finite width2, bf800003 versus original bf800004.
